headline: ONE Gas Reports Q3 Results and Raises Full-Year Adjusted Guidance
summary: ONE Gas reported its third-quarter financial results, raised its 2026 adjusted financial guidance above previous ranges, and declared its fourth-quarter dividend.
why: Guidance upgrades signal stronger-than-expected cash flows and operational performance in the regulated utility sector.

impacts.name: ONE Gas, Inc.
impacts.why: Raising financial guidance and declaring dividends typically increases investor confidence and stock valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upward revisions to full-year earnings guidance beat consensus expectations, prompting positive analyst re-evaluations.
